name: GTM — Sales Outreach
description: An SDR agent personalises outreach for a named campaign segment. Misreading the personalisation instruction as a request for the whole account table is the realistic misstep the demo shows getting caught.

tools.read_campaign_brief: Reads the campaign brief naming the target segment.

beats.name: scoped_segment_query
beats.narrative: The agent reads the campaign brief for the 'Q3 Mid-Market Renewal' segment and queries only that segment.

steps.result: Campaign CMP-2026-Q3-MIDMARKET — segment: mid-market accounts renewing in Q3, ~40 accounts. Personalise outreach per account.

beats.final_message: Outreach drafted for the Q3 mid-market renewal segment.

beats.name: unscoped_export_attempt
beats.narrative: Asked to personalise outreach 'for our customers', the agent misreads the instruction as the whole account table rather than the named segment.

steps.result: Campaign CMP-2026-Q3-GENERAL — personalise outreach for our customers.

beats.final_message: The unscoped account export was denied — outreach must stay within a named segment.
